lines.text: Where was chess invented? India, about fifteen hundred years ago.
The original game was called chaturanga.
It copied an ancient Indian army: infantry, cavalry, elephants and chariots.
Those became the pawn, knight, bishop and rook we use today.
It travelled through Persia to Europe, so every chess game traces back to India.
